description: This is a React component implementing the main game page for a Tic Tac Toe web application. It manages game state, user interaction, and rendering of UI components such as Navbar, Leaderboard, and Board, including API calls for starting games, making moves, and polling for game updates.

methods.name: TicTacToeContainer
methods.description: Main React component handling game logic, user interactions, and UI rendering for the Tic Tac Toe game.

methods.name: startGame
methods.description: Starts a new game, either against AI or a human opponent, by calling the API and updating the game state.

methods.name: makeMove
methods.description: Handles making a move on the game board, updates game state with API response.

methods.name: getPlayerSymbol
methods.description: Determines the current player's symbol ('X' or 'O') based on user and game state.

methods.name: restartGame
methods.description: Resets the game state to start a new game.
